mapper.select: SELECT t.training_id, t.date, e.parts_id, e.exercise_id, t.weight, t.reps FROM trainings t LEFT JOIN exercises e ON t.exercise_id = e.exercise_id WHERE t.training_id = #{trainingId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trainings (training_id, date, user_id, exercise_id, weight, reps, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{trainingId}, #{date}, #{userId}, #{exerciseId}, #{weight}, #{reps}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (training_id) DO UPDATE SET date=EXCLUDED.date, exercise_id=EXCLUDED.exercise_id, weight=EXCLUDED.weight, reps=EXCLUDED.reps, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM trainings WHERE training_id = #{trainingId} AND user_id = #{userId}
